answer: Nowhere in the app: srv/order-service.js registers on-handlers only for submit and approve, and package.json depends only on @sap/cds (no plugin), so nothing registers reject; a POST to the reject action is expected to return 501 Not Implemented. A recurring 'declared action, no handler, no plugin dependency' pattern is a candidate for a deterministic rule.

findings.title: Bound action reject has no implementation
findings.statement: reject is declared on OrderService.Orders and granted to Approver, but the service implementation only registers this.on('submit') and this.on('approve'); no loop, string-built or generic registration exists, and the only dependency is @sap/cds, so no plugin supplies it. The Fiori UI still offers a Reject button, so users can trigger an action that has no implementation.
findings.test: POST /orders/Orders(ID=aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000002,IsActiveEntity=true)/OrderService.reject {"reason":"x"} as carol; expected 501 Not Implemented
